newsitem.title: UK: British Land at record after H1 results.
newsitem.headline: British Land at record after H1 results.

text.p: Shares in British Land Plc set a record high on Tuesday after the real estate company posted an 81 percent rise in first-half profits coupled with an upbeat statement on prospects.
The stock was up 11-1/2p at 499 by 0905 GMT in modest trading of 318,002 shares, after earlier reaching a record 502p.
"We are very bullish on British Land," said one sales trader, "they are very good figures and British Land is one of the best stocks in the property sector."

Pre-tax profit rose to 34.2 million stg in the first half from 18.9 million a year before, at the top of the range of analyst expectations. Forecasts had mostly been in a range between 25.5 million stg and 35.0 million.
"The prospects for the areas where we are invested continue to improve," said chairman John Ritblat. "I view the second half with confidence in a competitive though still variable property market."
